subject: SAML assertion logs, SCIM delta export & role entitlement bundle
messages:
From: Carla Mendes <carla.mendes@nexgenlabs.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: security@nexgenlabs.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request: SAML assertions, SCIM deltas, and role matrix for SIG review

Hi Tessa,

We're running a SIG questionnaire for our upcoming vendor assessment and need a short bundle of artifacts to complete the access-control section. Can you provide the following by EOD Wednesday (our timezone):

- A small sample set of successful SAML assertions (redacted PII) covering SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows
- SCIM delta export for the last 7 days (CSV) showing create/update/deactivate events
- Current role entitlement matrix (spreadsheet) that maps roles to privileges and example least-privilege justification for admin-level roles
- Any notes on how RBAC is enforced and how role changes are audited

We can accept redacted samples and hashed identifiers. If you need a timeline extension, let me know — our compliance window is tight.

Thanks,
Carla Mendes
Security Program Manager
NexGen Labs

--
NexGen: security@nexgenlabs.com
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Carla Mendes <carla.mendes@nexgenlabs.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 17:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SAML assertions, SCIM deltas, and role matrix for SIG review

Hi Carla — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a redacted package that meets SIG requirements. Proposed plan:

1) Deliver a zipped evidence bundle with SAML assertions (JSON export), SCIM delta CSV (last 7 days), role entitlement matrix (XLSX) and a short PDF with least-privilege rationale and audit notes.
2) We'll redact any user-identifying attributes and replace with consistent hashed IDs.
3) Priyom will run the SCIM export; Naomi will pull RBAC/role snapshots and provide the justification doc.

Timeline: initial bundle by Tuesday EOD PT; final (signed) handoff by Wednesday if you need docs notarized. If that works, we'll upload to a shared drive link and paste HubSpot deal reference.

Questions: do you need samples from both SP and IdP initiated SSO flows, or is SP-only sufficient? Also, do you want assertion timestamps in UTC or in your local timezone?

Regards,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance (Redwood Inference)
T: +1 415-555-0192
E: tessa_morgan@redwood.com

Redwood Inference — securing inference for production
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SAML assertions, SCIM deltas, and role matrix for SIG review

Tessa / Naomi —

I'll take the SCIM delta export. Quick notes on extraction and redaction so external reviewers can validate without seeing PII:

- SCIM export: we'll pull scim_events table for 2027-05-18 through 2027-05-24 inclusive. CSV columns: event_id, timestamp_utc, operation (create/update/patch/deactivate), principal_hash, target_hash, attributes_changed
- principal_hash and target_hash will use SHA256 with a stable salt (we'll include the salt hash metadata but not the salt itself)
- We'll include canned examples showing how a create->update->deactivate sequence looks across rows

Markus — can you confirm the tool/version that produced the SAML logs (for assertion formatting) so we annotate the sample with the appropriate assertion schema version? Also, Naomi — please attach the role mapping snapshot and the short admin-justification note (1 page).

I'll stage scim_delta_export_20270522.csv on the secure drive by 14:00 PT and include a small README describing redaction and normalization.

Thanks,
Priyom
Engineering Security Operations
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Carla Mendes <carla.mendes@nexgenlabs.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence request: SAML assertions, SCIM deltas, and role matrix for SIG review

Carla — attaching the redacted bundle as discussed. Keys below and links to download:

Attachments included in the package (attached and uploaded to Drive):
- saml_assertion_samples_20270525.json (SP-initiated and IdP-initiated samples, attributes redacted; timestamps in UTC)
- scim_delta_export_20270522.csv (events 2027-05-18 -> 2027-05-24, stable hashed IDs; README included)
- role_entitlement_matrix_20270525.xlsx (current role -> permission mapping)
- least_privilege_justification_202705.pdf (one-page admin justification + how RBAC changes are audited)

Download (expires in 14 days): https://drive.redwood.com/shared/SAML-Samples-2027
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8492

Notes / provenance:
- SAML logs generated by AuthGateway v3.2 (we include the assertion namespace and schema comment in the JSON samples).
- SCIM exports produced by the provisioning pipeline (scim-provisioner v1.8), with a salt-hash metadata file included for reviewer verification.
- RBAC snapshot taken at 2027-05-25T08:00:00Z from the role-service.

If you need additional samples (e.g., failed assertions, metadata.xml), say the word and we'll add them. Happy to hop on a short call to walk through the bundle if your reviewer wants clarification.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
